snippet.title: Entropy Survivors - Announcement Trailer - Demo Out Now!
snippet.description:
Simultaneously control a powerful mech and a sharpshooting space frog in this bullet hell roguelike, with insane abilities, online co-op, huge bosses and customizable weapons and classes! Play alone or save the universe with up to 4 friends online! - Demo out now!
